items.title: 1MORE S20 Ultra Clip-On Earbuds Launch as New Open-Ear Standard
items.summary: 1MORE launched its flagship S20 Ultra clip-on open-ear earbuds on Sept 20, 2026, featuring a three-magnet acoustic architecture, Hi-Res Wireless LDAC, 360-degree surround sound and SDT Sound Focusing 2.0 to cut leakage. The C-shaped clip uses nickel-titanium memory wire rated for 10,000 bends.

items.title: Realme Buds T500 Pro Harry Potter Edition Debuts in India
items.summary: Realme unveiled the Buds T500 Pro Harry Potter Edition in India on Sept 21, 2026 alongside the Realme 16 Pro. The limited run of 5,000 units packs 12.4mm titanium-coated drivers, up to 50dB ANC, LHDC 5.0, Bluetooth 6.1 triple-device connect and 56h total battery.

items.title: Belkin Expands SoundForm Lineup at IFA 2026 with Affordable ANC
items.summary: At IFA 2026 Belkin added three audio products: SoundForm Isolate Buds (up to 45dB ANC, 32h battery, $59.99), SoundForm Dot (ANC and non-ANC, 30h, from $34.99) and SoundForm Play ANC over-ear headphones for kids with an 85dB limiter.

items.title: The Best Wireless Earbuds of 2026: Lab-Tested by Experts
items.summary: GearOpen's expert lab ranks 2026 wireless earbuds across ANC, sound and battery. Standouts include the JBL Tour Pro 3 (84% noise reduction, LDAC), Moondrop Space Travel (sub-$30 ANC) and the Apple AirPods Pro 3 leading at 90% average noise reduction.

items.title: Best True Wireless Earbuds 2026: AirPods Pro 3, Sony, Bose, Sennheiser Compared
items.summary: SolderMag compares flagship TWS for 2026 by priority: Technics EAH-AZ100 for overall, Sony WF-1000XM5 for Android, Bose QuietComfort Ultra for ANC and Sennheiser MOMENTUM TW 4 for sound. The guide stresses fit, multipoint and codec support over spec-sheet marketing.

items.title: Apple Holds TWS Lead as Market Slows, Open-Ear Surges
items.summary: Omdia data for Q2 2026 shows total TWS shipments fell 0.7% YoY while Apple rose 1.2% to 16.8M units and 20.5% share. Open wireless stereo jumped 12%, with Shokz up 107.9% YoY; Omdia forecasts OWS to more than double to 90.5M units by 2030.

items.title: IDC: Clip-On Earbuds Jump 82.2% as Open-Ear Hits 12.33M Units
items.summary: IDC reports Q2 2026 clip-on earbuds surged 82.2% YoY, now over 60% of the 12.33M-unit open-ear category (+35%). Earwear overall reached 96.13M units (+5.4%). China drove more than 60% of open-ear shipments, with brands like Bose, Anker, JBL and Xiaomi entering clip-on.

items.title: Conventional Wireless Earbuds Post First Annual Drop in Three Years
items.summary: GCN reports global TWS shipments slipped 0.7% YoY to about 82M in Q2 2026, the first annual decline since 2023, while open wireless stereo grew 12% to 11.1M units (13.5% share). Sub-$50 open-ear shipments leapt 323% YoY, signaling demand at both ends of the price range.

items.title: 10 Best Wireless Earbuds (September 2026)
items.summary: World Is Round's 90-day test of 47 pairs shortlists 2026 earbuds: Apple AirPods Pro 3 (editor's choice), Samsung Galaxy Buds 4 Pro (premium) and TOZO NC9 (budget, IPX8, 60h). The roundup weights ANC, battery with case and ecosystem fit over raw price.

items.title: Open-Ear Battery Life Is the Only True Differentiator, Says Analysis
items.summary: A 2026 open-ear analysis finds audio quality differences marginal across brands, with battery endurance the real value split: Bose Ultra Open lasts 7h at $300 while the $60 Baseus Bowie MC2 delivers 13h and IP67. Case capacity ranges 19.5h (Bose) to 60h (Baseus).
